backend/main.mo: Actor implementing user profiles, stats, availability, chat, and daily log management with access control and several query helpers.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light/dark theme variables and base styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application router and authentication gate wiring pages, layout, and initial leaderboard setup.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen shown to users lacking admin permissions with a return-to-calendar button.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login screen with branded card UI, background image, and Internet Identity login button.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Simple logo component rendering the configured branding image.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Chat UI that loads recent messages, allows sending new ones, and handles scrolling and message visibility toggling.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: App layout wrapper providing top bar, navigation, main content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Navigation bar showing route buttons and conditionally adding an admin link based on user role.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Top bar with logo, theme toggle, user avatar menu, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Profile editor allowing users to update their name and profile picture with upload validation and progress.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Displays the user's weekly, monthly, and all‑time leaderboard ranks with loading states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Shows the user's match history including wins and losses per day with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal prompting new users to enter their name and save their initial profile.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wrapper adding a faint fixed background image behind all content.
Renders an avatar with initials fallback and a display name in configurable sizes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches backend actors tied to the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks to fetch and update the caller's user profile using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Exposes hooks to fetch the caller's user role and check admin status via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an authentication context for Internet Identity, managing login, stored identities, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains various data-fetching and mutation hooks for profiles, availability, leaderboards, and history using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Manages light/dark theme state with localStorage persistence and DOM class updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Provides hooks to resolve principals to display names or profiles, with optional avatar support.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining light/dark theme CSS variables and global styles.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports static branding metadata including app name and logo.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Utility functions for day IDs, date conversion, calendar grids, and date/time formatting.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point wiring React, Internet Identity provider, React Query, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Form page to add or edit a user's availability for a specific day, including time selection and notes, with data loaded and saved via hooks.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard for managing users and all availabilities, including viewing, sorting, and deleting entries.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Monthly calendar view showing days with availability and links to add availability or view day details, plus an embedded chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Standalone page displaying the group chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Displays all availabilities for a selected day with user info and allows editing or deleting the caller's availability.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Leaderboard interface with weekly, monthly, and all-time filters, allowing users to record or remove wins and losses.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Profile page showing user info, leaderboard rankings, and recent match history.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Utility functions for converting files to Uint8Array and generating name initials for avatars.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Provides helpers for generating time selection options, formatting time strings, and parsing them into validated components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Implements utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session-stored values, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS with custom colors, container settings, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s state, features, and pending requests related to leaderboard win/loss decrement functionality.
